title: project scope outside a git checkout is an environment error (exit 3) that names the folder
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). From the home folder, which is not a git checkout, project scope exits 3 with `is not inside a git checkout` on stderr, empty stdout, and writes nothing. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
